name: shakers-cli
description: Shakers AI usage & skills evaluator: a local-first CLI (`shakers` binary) plus a local MCP server. Commands: ai-usage (scan + classify your AI-tool setup, T0-T7), certify (certify Skills from your code), share (branded LinkedIn card).

scripts.publish:beta: node scripts/prepare-beta.js && npm publish --tag latest && git checkout -- package.json README.md
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings bin src scripts test test-fixtures
